module_summary: Virtual-FIFO decoder: parses per-segment headers into a segmented control FIFO, then re-aligns segments to extract AXI-stream frames into an output FIFO register stage.

anchors.name: input_ctrl_data
anchors.why: Segment header words decoded for start, last, length and parity

anchors.name: input_ctrl_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment header valid feeding seg_valid

anchors.name: input_ctrl_ready
anchors.why: Header ready asserted when all segments valid and control FIFO not half full

anchors.name: input_data
anchors.why: Segmented payload data from which output beats are extracted

anchors.name: input_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment payload valid, latched in expand mode

anchors.name: input_ready
anchors.why: Payload ready from consumed-segment register

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream data from output FIFO register

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from m_axis_tvalid_reg

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready popping the output FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker from output FIFO

anchors.name: sts_hdr_parity_err
anchors.why: Reports header parity error detected during parsing

anchors.name: fifo_rst_in
anchors.why: Channel reset clearing parser, FIFO pointers and output state

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Header parser in-frame state; set on start-of-packet, cleared at frame end

anchors.name: seg_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Remaining segments in current frame; detects last segment for eop/end

anchors.name: last_reg
anchors.why: Frame is last of packet; sets ctrl FIFO last flag

anchors.name: extra_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Extra segment needed for straddling tail; emits eop next segment

anchors.name: last_straddle_reg
anchors.why: Last data straddles segment boundary; selects extra-cycle path

anchors.name: seg_hdr_start_pkt
anchors.why: Decoded start-of-packet header bit starting a frame

anchors.name: seg_hdr_len
anchors.why: Decoded header length giving segment count and last length

anchors.name: seg_hdr_parity_err
anchors.why: Header parity check result raising parity error

anchors.name: ctrl_fifo_wr_en
anchors.why: Writes parsed sop/eop/end/last flags into control FIFO segments

anchors.name: ctrl_fifo_half_full
anchors.why: Control FIFO half full; back-pressures header acceptance

anchors.name: ctrl_fifo_seg[*].seg_mem_sop
anchors.why: Per-segment control FIFO memory (representative of sop/eop/end/last arrays)

anchors.name: ctrl_fifo_seg[*].seg_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Control FIFO segment write pointer

anchors.name: ctrl_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Control FIFO segment read pointer

anchors.name: ctrl_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Control FIFO read output valid per segment

anchors.name: ctrl_fifo_seg[*].seg_empty
anchors.why: Segment control FIFO empty; gates read prefetch

anchors.name: ctrl_fifo_rd_en
anchors.why: Pops consumed segments from control FIFO

anchors.name: out_frame_reg
anchors.why: Output re-packer in-frame state between sop and end segments

anchors.name: out_seg_offset_reg
anchors.why: Current segment offset rotating control flags for alignment

anchors.name: output_offset_reg
anchors.why: Output beat segment offset register

anchors.name: out_seg_consumed_reg
anchors.why: Registered consumed-segment mask driving input_ready

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Contiguous valid segments available for output beat

anchors.name: out_abort
anchors.why: Aborts beat when segments missing or output not ready

anchors.name: out_done
anchors.why: Output beat complete; stops further segment consumption

anchors.name: out_ctrl_en_reg
anchors.why: Registered beat-emit enable becoming m_axis_tvalid_int

anchors.name: out_ctrl_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Header beat flag loading tid/tdest/tuser metadata

anchors.name: out_ctrl_last_reg
anchors.why: Last beat flag driving tlast and partial tkeep

anchors.name: out_ctrl_last_len_reg
anchors.why: Last beat byte length used to build tkeep

anchors.name: out_ctrl_seg_offset_reg
anchors.why: Selects starting segment for data and metadata extraction

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Extracted output beat data shifted from input segments, written to output FIFO

anchors.name: input_data_full
anchors.why: Duplicated segment data window for shifting extraction

anchors.name: input_data_int_reg
anchors.why: Holds previous segment data in expand-input mode

anchors.name: axis_tuser_reg
anchors.why: Frame tuser metadata captured from header, held for frame

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int
anchors.why: Internal ready from output FIFO half-full, gates beat emission

anchors.name: out_fifo_tdata
anchors.why: Output FIFO data memory buffering extracted beats

anchors.name: out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO write pointer

anchors.name: out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO read pointer

anchors.name: out_fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO half full; drives internal ready

anchors.name: out_fifo_full
anchors.why: Output FIFO full blocks writes

anchors.name: out_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Output FIFO empty blocks output register load

groups.name: Header parser
groups.description: Decodes segment headers and tracks frame segment counts and parity

groups.name: Segmented control FIFO
groups.description: Per-segment FIFOs storing sop/eop/end/last flags between parser and re-packer

groups.name: Output re-packer
groups.description: Aligns and consumes segments into output beats with header/last control

groups.name: Data extraction
groups.description: Shifts segment data and header metadata into output beat fields

groups.name: Output FIFO
groups.description: Distributed-RAM FIFO and output register driving the AXI stream
